items.html: *Also know that this Tzelem is composed of two, and it is the first Tzelem of Mochin from the side of Ima, and the second Tzelem from the side of Aba. And they are one within the other, the Tzelem of Aba within the Tzelem of Ima. And first the internal ones of the Tzelem of Ima enter, and then the surrounding ones, and afterward the internal ones of the Tzelem of Aba, and then the surrounding ones. And the Mem of the Tzelem comes clothed within the KHB of Tevuna, and the Lamed within the HGT of Tevuna, and the Tzadi within the NHY of the third Tevuna, which is the second; and their parallels are the Tzelem of the Mochin of Aba.
